en: Black‑and‑white image showing a large historic building with a multi‑tiered tower and onion‑shaped dome roofs, standing on a hillside. Below the structure are terraced vineyards with stone retaining walls; a lone person is working among the vines. The style of the building is Central European, reminiscent of a manor or small palace overlooking wine‑growing slopes. No visible printed text appears on the image side.
